name: v1
basis: v0 plus terms from first principles, checked on the 330 tracks of a private library (ffmpeg 9.0.1, core set). Offsets unchanged from v0.
inputs: source size (whole file), floored integer duration, source bps/rate/channels, output bps/rate/channels, regime (R0-R4), summed gain dB, playback speed, seek
duration: d = floored duration + 0.5 s; effective length = (d - seek) / speed
src_bits: src_ratio * bps_src, with src_ratio = size / (rate_src * bps_src/8 * ch_src * d)

bits_out.resample: + c * log2(rate_src / rate_out) when rate_out < rate_src

resample_c.status: PROVISIONAL: 5 tracks, one artist (96 kHz -> 48 kHz); to be set from the admin library

fallback: 0.747 for R4 (dynamic loudnorm), lossy or uncompressed sources, unknown size, DSP other than plain gains
not_included: bits the source really uses (not known before headers)
